name: AgentRender
description: Turns a URL into a screenshot (returned as an image), a PDF, or a structured extract (title, main text, links) using the hosted AgentRender render API, so agents do not need to run a headless browser. Includes a get_free_key tool that issues a free API key (150 renders/month, no card).

AGENTRENDER_API_KEY.description: AgentRender API key (akr_...). Free and instant at https://agentrenderapi.com, or obtain one in-session with the get_free_key tool.
